title: Define and prove the focal Living Core sphere contract
objective: Turn the approved Living Core sphere capability into a bounded focal-product contract covering spherical depth, scale, crop, single-object motion, Wings, surfaces, responsive behaviour and exact static fallback without changing the canonical disc or renderer.

included: approved spherical shading over the existing Living Core palette and Deep Mineral finish
canonical white Wings placement and fixed geometry
feature, hero and immersive sphere scale and crop rules
one focal animated sphere per viewport
light, off-white, dark and contained hero surfaces
responsive, reduced-motion, WebGL-failure, overflow and crop proof
source, exact static twin and runtime approximation comparison
excluded: new gradient palettes, product names or assignments
Living Core renderer or Deep Mineral finish changes
product cards, pills, trading cards, stacks or collections

acceptance: one schema-validated source defines depth, scale, crop, Wings, allocation, surface and accessibility rules
the generated contract is deterministic and preserves the canonical disc, gradients, renderer and foundations
candidate status and promotion authority are explicit
source, exact static twin, flat disc and focal sphere are compared honestly
one approved product proves feature, hero and immersive crops without implying homepage approval
light, dark, reduced-motion, WebGL-failure and 320-to-1440 responsive states are visible
human verdict can be recorded without changing canonical inputs

verification.passCondition: sphere shading uses the approved renderer shape and Deep Mineral finish without a new palette or CSS glow
canonical disc, source PNG, exact static twin, renderer, Wings, product assignment and foundation hashes remain unchanged
one focal animated sphere remains distinct from static disc and repeated-product roles
feature, hero and immersive crops remain intentional without ellipse distortion or horizontal overflow from 320 to 1440
reduced motion and WebGL failure retain exact colour, fixed Wings, dimensions and accessible product naming
Olli approves the focal sphere contract for promotion

humanGate.approvalQuestion: Does this sphere feel like a rare, premium focal state of the same Mez product core—dimensional enough to earn a hero moment without becoming a generic glowing orb?

stopConditions: a build changes canonical disc-contract-01, source PNG, extracted palette, exact static twin, renderer, Wings, product assignment or foundation
the sphere gains a halo, external glow cloud, floating decoration, pulse, bounce, scroll reveal or non-spherical geometry
more than one production sphere animates in a viewport
the task introduces cards, stacks, homepage composition, Figma or consumer-specific work
runtime approximation is presented as exact source colour
notes: Begin with a read-only comparison of the canonical flat disc, renderer sphere mask and historical sphere evidence.
Use the same approved product core and Wings geometry; depth is the only new expression variable under review.
This task locks the sphere contract only; the expression-family gate remains later programme work.
